section.p: The seat bolster provides firm support to the driver’s side while driving, which helps prevent the upper body from leaning to the side during turns. This improves stability and control while driving, especially during sporty or aggressive driving.

li.p: Turn the seat bolster adjustment switch clockwise and the seatback bolster will be tightened.
Turn the seat bolster adjustment switch counterclockwise and the seatback bolster will be loosened.

To adjust the seat bolster adjustment switch height to the maximum, turn the seat bolster adjustment switch clockwise for approximately 8 seconds. After reaching the maximum position, the seat bolster position will not change even if you continue to operate the seat bolster adjustment switch. Simply take your hand off the switch at this point.
